title: Budget and authority boundaries

checks.name: the existing Deszo managed-invocation, reservation, permit and authority tests pass
the App Server refuses a turn that carries no host-issued reservation
checks.detail: a turn with no reservation was admitted and emitted turn/started; enforcement must sit in the adapter and at the process boundary

notes: The Codex client did not enforce a host reservation. This is a boundary fact about the App Server, not about Deszo. The ADR must place enforcement in the adapter (sole path to turn/start, holding the only credential) and in the process boundary.
Deszo side: the test names matched are listed in the TAP file. Full suite evidence (578/578) is recorded separately.

Not observed here: whether an exhausted budget or expired authority would be extended by a real Codex turn, and what a provider charges. Both need a signed-in session and provider usage telemetry (see the POC-03 blocker). The status is FAIL on the boundary check alone; the unobserved items are not counted as passes.
